records.title: BigPower: Hierarchical Source-Level Module Power Estimation for CPUs with Large Language Models
records.reason: Primary text uses LLMs to estimate hierarchical CPU-module power from source/RTL data. The predicted object is CPU power, not LLM inference power or efficiency; no LLM serving method is proposed.

records.title: GraphInfer-Bench: Benchmarking LLM's Inference Capability on Graphs
records.reason: Primary full text contributes a graph-reasoning capability benchmark/dataset and compares LLM/GNN task performance. It does not reduce inference compute, memory, latency, or serving cost.

records.title: Smart Lead Generation Chatbot
records.reason: The IEEE primary-source page could not be retrieved, so the supplied lead-generation chatbot abstract and its relation to LLM inference/efficiency cannot be verified from a primary source.

records.title: Routing-Aware Expert Calibration for Machine Unlearning in Mixture-of-Experts Language Models
records.reason: The arXiv record confirms a withdrawn MoE-LLM machine-unlearning paper and provides the abstract, but states no PDF is available and the HTML endpoint is 404; linked MoE lineage cannot be checked against body text.

records.title: Attention Expansion: Enhancing Keyphrase Extraction from Long Documents with Attention-Augmented Contextualized Embeddings
records.reason: Primary arXiv abstract/full text concerns attention-augmented contextual embeddings for keyphrase extraction with PLMs; it avoids expensive LLM-based inference by using lightweight encoders rather than improving LLM inference.
